snippet.title: ROCK BAND | Teaser #1
snippet.description:
You're the lead guitarist. Your drummer is drunk. Your bassist is missing. The venue opens in two hours.

This is not a setback. This is Tuesday.

Rock Band Simulator is a chaotic first-person rock band life sim about keeping an underground rock band alive, surviving the neighbourhood, and somehow making it to the next concert.

Manage your band. Take odd jobs. Start fights. Make questionable decisions. Then get on stage and try to turn the mess into music.

Support us on:

KICKSTARTER
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rockbandsimulator/rock-band-simulator
